name: Iida
source: Panchuu is also one of the transfered boys but he is 1 year older than Kazushi and his friends so he is their senpai. His speech is very difficult to understand. Kazushi and his friends look up to him as a big brother figure. He likes bread and his family owns a bakery called "Iida Bakery".
translation: Panchuu is also one of the transfered boys but he is 1 year older than Kazushi and his friends so he is their senpai. His speech is very difficult to understand.
